title: Intraperitoneal Glucose Tolerance Test Protocol
author: Fawaz G. Haj
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yp4fvqw

steps.title: Fast the mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice for 16 hours by removing food the day before at 3:00 pm.

steps.title: Calibrate glucose meter
steps.instruction: Calibrate the glucose meter according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Collect baseline blood glucose
steps.instruction: Deprive mice from water and collect a baseline blood sample.

substeps.instruction: Remove approximately 5 μl of blood (one drop) from the tail via a tail tip cut.
Transfer blood directly onto a glucose indicator strip.
Measure blood glucose immediately in a glucometer.

steps.title: Administer glucose injection
steps.instruction: Give the mouse an intraperitoneal injection of Glucose (2g/kg) using a 27 G needle.

steps.title: Collect post-injection blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from the initial tail cut at specific time intervals and monitor the mice.

substeps.instruction: Take blood samples at 15, 30, 60, and 120 min post-injection.
Return the mouse to its cage between time points and monitor it every minute.

steps.title: Post-experiment tail care
steps.instruction: Ensure hemostasis and clean the tail before returning the animal to the cage.

substeps.instruction: Wipe tail with 70% alcohol and allow to dry.
Ensure blood loss from the tail has stopped before placing the animal back to its cage.
